newsitem.title: GERMANY: Horlick in talks with unnamed Deutsche official.
newsitem.headline: Horlick in talks with unnamed Deutsche official.

text.p: Nicola Horlick, former head of British pension fund business at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Asset Management, met an unnamed Deutsche Bank official for talks after her arrival at Deutsche's headquarters.
Horlick was greeted in the reception area by a Deutsche Bank official who invited her to come upstairs for talks with a Deutsche Bank official, whom he declined to name.
Horlick hesitated initially, saying she wanted to be met in the reception area, but then agreed to go up to the meeting accompanied by a Reuters reporter, who volunteered to act as a witness.
Before she entered the building she posed for photographers and cameramen.
Asked if she planed to sue MGAM, she said: "I will be guided by my lawyers."
Horlick was suspended earlier this week pending the outcome of an investigation into what Deutsche Morgan Grenfell described as "a potential breach of her contract" and Horlick resigned on Thursday.
